summary: Synthetic HIGH vulnerability in pdos-vuln-fixture-high 1.0.0 (test fixture).
details: Deterministic, hermetic OSV advisory used only by the pyforge-warden (Warden) test suite to prove Story 1.6's severity gate HIGH-severity -> warn/exit-0 composition path end to end through a real osv-scanner run (as opposed to PDOS-FIXTURE-0001's CRITICAL -> policy-violation/exit-1 path). Affects the synthetic PyPI package `pdos-vuln-fixture-high` at the single explicit version 1.0.0. There is no such real package. The CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H vector empirically computes to base score 8.8 (osv-scanner 2.4.0, verified against the real binary) -- inside this project's HIGH band [7.0, 9.0).
